overview: Later Liang was the first of the Five Dynasties that ruled northern China between the Tang and Song. Founded by Zhu Wen, a former rebel who deposed the last Tang emperor, it controlled only part of northern China and faced constant military threats.

items.text: Kaifeng developed as the capital, though smaller and less cosmopolitan than Tang Chang'an.
The Five Dynasties period saw the rise of military strongmen who dominated politics.
Printing technology continued to develop during this unstable period.

fall.text: Li Cunxu of Later Tang conquered Later Liang and captured its capital Kaifeng in 923.
